scope: Training/validation result metadata only; no test input or score access.

totals.note: Evaluation rows may repeat an existing model/comparator; they are not unique fits. Do not sum wall times: some controls are included in parent stage time.

accounting_definitions.configuration_instances: Distinct settings inside one stage; repeated seeds/stages and meta designs are explicitly separated in each family's accounting.
accounting_definitions.fit_executions: A new optimizer/model.fit invocation. Early-stop training and subsequent fresh refit count separately; max/mean scoring does not.
accounting_definitions.OOF: Each newly fitted outer-fold head counts; copied OOF logits/metadata and downstream reuse do not.
accounting_definitions.best: The reported validation result follows each study's selection protocol, never a post-hoc favorable diagnostic seed.

verification_runs.purpose: Independent reproduction of the already selected checkpoint; not another model-selection comparison.
